body:
### Summary

I have `ipython` in my project, listed under the dev dependency group:

```toml
dependencies = [ ... ]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["ipython", ... ]
```

I want to update it in my lock file so I ran: `uv upgrade ipython`, but it doesn't work. Then I tried `uv upgrade --dev ipython`, assuming it understood that argument, since many other subcommands do. But it doesn't.

```sh
uv upgrade ipython
error: Dependency `ipython` was not found in `project.dependencies`
uv upgrade --dev ipython
error: unexpected argument '--dev' found
```

How is one supposed to upgrade a non-main dep group dependency without manually updating the version range/pin in the pyproject.toml file?

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04

### Version

uv 0.13.7 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

3.14.7
title: `uv upgrade` is not aware of other dependency groups
